About this Event

Holi Fest 2026 - Festival of Colors
Join us for the most vibrant and joyous celebration of colors - Holi Fest 2024! Get ready to immerse yourself in a day filled with laughter, music, and endless fun. This in-person event will take place on Saturday March 7th, 2026 at 180 Woz Way, San Jose, CA 95110.
Experience the essence of Holi as you indulge in the traditional throwing of vibrant colored powders, known as Gulal. Dance to the beats of lively music and let the rhythm guide your moves. Capture unforgettable moments with your loved ones amidst the kaleidoscope of colors.
Whether you're a Holi enthusiast or new to this exhilarating festival, Holi Fest promises unforgettable experience. So, gather your friends and family, and come join us for a day of non-stop festivities and pure joy!
